Name: (CP) Hitme's Robin Is Single Revised
Author: Hitme11
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4]Robin Is Single is a mod that change Robin lore to become one of Demetrius children, which is a [i]*subtle*  [/i]way[i] [/i]to make her datable without affecting (hurting) Demetrius. 

[/color]Since the original mod is unplayable with Stardew Valley Expanded because of various compatible issues and the author had given the permission to update their mod, I decided to revise this mod with more features.

[color=#f4f4f4][b]FEATURES:[/b]
-Demetrius' wife is now Jeanette, and Robin is either Demetrius' oldest daughter or his platonic best friend (for people who want Robin to be [i]lore-friendly[/i] as much as possible). NEW: remove Demetrius mentioning Jeanette if using 'Custom' relationship. 
- Added a small new room for Robin for those who find it weird for Robin and Demetrius to sleep in the same bed when they are not a couple.
- Added 4 new small events for Robin from the original mod, fixing numerous typos and awkward positions.
- Changed vanilla events and dialogue mentioning Robin to match her updated status.
- New Robin marriage dialogue (with typo fixes). 
- Robin custom kiss sprite and flower dance sprite, both vanilla and seasonal.
- Robin spouse room with a vanilla shop (require Robin to be in her room) and a telephone shop (can be used even she isn't in her room).
- ﻿Robin spouse area and her animation.[/color]

﻿[b][color=#ff7700]ISSUES:[/color][/b]
- [b]Known Issues:[/b]
Robin doing upgrade animation in spouse room, and she will work like there is no tomorrow.
[color=#ffff00]After marriage, Robin won't go to work sometime if it raining outside (due to how the game work), she may also not in her spouse room often (also due to how the game work), which limited your [/color][color=#ffff00]opportunity to upgrade buildings. I tried my best to keep her from being lazy but you may likely encounter this problem if you're married to her. Please use [/color][color=#ffff00][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self Serve for 1.6[/url] to fix this issue.[/color]


[b]INSTRUCTION:
[/b]- [b]For Seasonal Cuter Outfits user, you must [color=#ff7700]turn on 'SeasonalRobin' in the SCO config[/color]. I[b] used patch method instead load so it won't work correctly if you turn it off.[/b][/b]
- Put the file [CP] Robin Is Single in into Mods folder
- Open config.json in [CP] Robin Is Single or open through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] in-game.
- ﻿In config.json:
﻿type Daughter between " " if you want Robin to be Demetrius' daughter, type Friend if you want her to be his friend. Default is Daughter. NEW: Type Custom and define their relationship if you want to use custom relationship.
﻿type true in SeperateRoom if you want Robin to have her own room. Default is true.
[b]
COMPATIBILITY:
[/b]-[b] SVE: [/b]The mod can now run alongside Stardew Valley Expanded without crashing. However, some content added by SVE may or may not sync with this mod.
- [b]Seasonal Cuter Characters:[/b] Due to how character sprites work in SDV, a complete change was necessary for her to be able to kiss/flower dance. Fortunately, a built-in patch is now included (you can now kiss her in winter outfit).
﻿!!Please contact me via comment section if you want me to take it down!!
[b]- Other mod that change Robin character sprite: may not compatible[/b], it wont break your game but there is a minor bug that her kissing animation would not play correctly. 
[b]- Other mod that change or add new dialogue: [/b]compatible, however some dialogue would not make sense in context, for example calling her Sebastion's mother or Demetrius' wife.
[b]- Other mod that add new events at ScienceHouse map: [/b]may or may not compatible if you turn on a seperate room for Robin and that event play specificially in her room. In that case, I advise turning it off or downloading the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip mod[/url].
- [b]Fonz's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3239]The Robin Romance Mod[/url]: Mostly incompatible. I highly recommend you to check their mod description to determine which suits you better.[/b]
